UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores public-facing information about a user.

id.description: The user's unique ID, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

Rider.title: Rider
Rider.description: Stores detailed information about a boda boda rider.

id.description: The unique ID for the rider, corresponding to their UserProfile ID.

contractStart.description: The start date of the rider's contract.

contractEnd.description: The end date of the rider's contract.

bikeId.description: The ID of the bike assigned to the rider.

active.description: Whether the rider is currently active.

dailyFee.description: The daily fee the rider is required to pay.

plateNumber.description: The license plate number of the assigned boda.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the rider was added.

Bike.title: Bike
Bike.description: Represents a motorcycle (boda boda) in the fleet.

id.description: The unique ID for the bike.

plateNumber.description: The license plate number of the bike.

currentRiderId.description: The ID of the rider currently assigned to this bike.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a single payment made by a rider.

id.description: The unique ID for the payment.

riderId.description: The ID of the rider who made the payment.

amount.description: The amount of the payment in TZS.

date.description: The date the payment was recorded for.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the payment record was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public profiles for all users.

/riders/{riderId}.description: Stores detailed profiles for users with the 'rider' role.

/bodas/{bodaId}.description: Collection of all motorcycles in the fleet.

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Collection of all payment records from riders.

/roles_admin/{userId}.description: Documents here indicate the user ID is an admin. Document can be empty.

/roles_supervisor/{userId}.description: Documents here indicate the user ID is a supervisor. Document can be empty.
